title: Friday Night Magic 2008: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Dominaria's most extravagant crypt nevertheless holds an empty grave.
Gaea needs no book to record every act.
The limbs of Pendelhaven extend as far as the meek roam, and reach as high as they strive.
"Think of this new life not as a gift from the angels but as a command to fight for their cause once more." —War blessing of Serra
Root systems in Mwonvuli twist through currents of mana rather than soil.
Raissa transformed herself into a vessel for the Watchword Codex, allowing the arcane lore to flow through her body.
To the Krark Clan, every artifact has a trigger and a barrel.
